terminus.finding: A 2012 workshop record shows participation rising after professional-looking submission requirements were relaxed; a 2015 student group record shows progress after an impossibly broad problem was narrowed to a tractable target.
terminus.generated: PARTICIPATION THRESHOLD: participation can be blocked by at least two distinct thresholds—entry-format threshold and action-scope threshold. Lowering the first and narrowing the second may convert concern into action without assuming motivation itself changed.
terminus.next: actively seek counterexamples where relaxed formats or narrowed scope still fail because trust, motivation, time or resources dominate
